license_summary: Official ambientCG license permits copying, modification, redistribution, commercial use and inclusion of raw asset files in a game, without attribution requirements.
creation_technique: Procedural (as identified by official page); not a photoscan.
physical_dimensions_source: Official asset page states approximate dimensions 1.4 m x 1.4 m.
visual_review: Dense short green/olive lawn with fine blade variation. No paving, rocks, exposed mud paths, or tall weed clumps visible. Fits maintained lawn better than Poly Haven sparse/leafy/dead/dirty candidates.
integration_recommendations: Diffuse uses sRGB; normal and roughness use no color space / linear data.
Use physical repeat approximately one tile per 1.4 m; avoid enlarging blade scale.
Use restrained tangent-space normal amplitude and geometric blades only in a near-camera band if performance permits.
Raw roughness image is dark. Remap toward matte range 0.78-0.97 or omit map and choose high material roughness; multiplying an already dark map by material roughness=1 does not raise it.
Diffuse is natural olive rather than vivid synthetic green. Calibrate scene lighting before boosting saturation.
Original 1K JPGs total 5.18 MB; production recompression is reasonable.
selection_limitation: No clean short-grass photoscan was established from allowed primary providers. Poly Haven official grass category has only grass_ground (dirty worn turf), leafy_grass (leaves/twigs), sparse_grass (visible soil/roots), withered_grass (dead brown grass). Selected clean procedural PBR material instead and labeled technique accurately.

runtime_preparation.colour: JPEG quality89, retains natural albedo; no artificial green tint
runtime_preparation.roughness: Linear remap: 211 + source/255 * 37, stored lossless. Avoids the original low roughness/waxy lawn.
